item.title: Firefox SpiderMonkey Generator For-in Iterator Use-After-Free (CVE-2026-2763)
item.description: Critical severity (CVSS 9.8) — binary · CVE-2026-2763 / MFSA 2026-13, 2026-14, 2026-15, 2026-16. Status: PoC (research-grade exploit harness; successful OOB access not independently verified). Affects: Mozilla Firefox and Thunderbird, SpiderMonkey JavaScript engine (for-in iteration and generators). Tags: firefox, thunderbird, spidermonkey, javascript-engine, use-after-free, for-in, generator, proxy, garbage-collection, CWE-416, browser, out-of-bounds.
